line.speaker: narrator
line.text: Ashmaw lowers its head. The sliver of the ford's fallen ember in the wall gutters once, then crumbles into grey dust. Nothing remains to sell or carry. A heavy claw rests warm against the stone.
line.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.
